title: Functional truth-set entry for the A/B quality gate (M3)
description: One expert-annotated final requirement used by tools/ab_runner.py to compute final-XLSX precision/recall/F1 and per-kind preservation rates (DEATOMIZATION_REMEDIATION_PLAN §5.1). document_id is matched against the parsed-dir name or the 'sha256:<blocks.jsonl sha256>' document key; entries with document_id '*' apply to every document (annotation fixture convenience only). Customer wording must never be committed: the repository keeps only this schema plus synthetic fixtures; real truth sets are passed via machine-local --truth paths.

truth_id.description: Stable unique id within one truth file; duplicate ids are rejected loudly at load time.

document_id.description: Owning document: parsed-dir basename, 'sha256:<hex>' document key, or '*' for document-agnostic rows.

section_id.description: Source clause label in the parser's coordinate space (e.g. '4.1'). Compared for exact equality after whitespace strip + casefold.

expected_text.description: Expected final requirement body text. Matching uses deterministic content-token coverage (functional_extract._content_tokens).

conditions.description: Expected condition clauses. A condition counts as preserved when its content tokens are covered >= 0.6 by the matched final-XLSX row text.

exceptions.description: Expected exception clauses; same preservation rule as conditions.

negations.description: Expected negated behaviours; same preservation rule as conditions.

numbers.description: Expected numeric literals (e.g. '15', '0.5'). Preserved on exact numeric equality with a number extracted from the matched row; a different extracted number is a conflict.

units.description: Expected unit tokens (e.g. 'kWh', 'min'). Preserved on letter-boundary-aware case-insensitive presence; presence of another recognized unit instead is a conflict.

codes.description: Expected coded identifiers (e.g. OBIS '0.0.1.0.0.255'). Preserved on case-insensitive squashed-text presence; presence of another dotted code instead is a conflict.

annotation_status.description: real = genuine expert annotation; fixture = synthetic self-proof entry that never masquerades as a real annotation. Informational for ab_runner (reported, not filtered).
